title: reviews.aggregates_by_keys
description: Batch form of reviews.aggregate: the module-owned rating aggregate for many targets in one call. This is the live_query half of a host rating Projection — stapel_core.comm.projections.read() calls it with {"keys": [...]} in local mode and returns the answer straight to the caller. Response: {target_key: {"avg": number, "count": integer}}; keys with no published review are absent from the result rather than present with zeros.

keys.description: Target keys to look up. An empty array returns {}.

target_type.description: Optional narrowing. The core Projection primitive sends only `keys`, so this is absent on that path and the counts then span every target type sharing a key — harmless for UUID keys, not for short per-type slugs.
